Using \(s=90\):

\[
A=\sqrt{90(90-30)(90-70)(90-80)}
=\sqrt{90\cdot60\cdot20\cdot10}
=\sqrt{1{,}080{,}000}
=600\sqrt3
\]

Altitude \(h\) to side 80 satisfies:

\[
\frac12\cdot 80\cdot h = 600\sqrt3
\Rightarrow 40h=600\sqrt3
\Rightarrow h=15\sqrt3
\]

Let the segment adjacent to side 30 be \(x\). Then:

\[
x^2+h^2=30^2
\Rightarrow x^2+(15\sqrt3)^2=900
\Rightarrow x^2+675=900
\Rightarrow x=15
\]

The other segment is \(80-15=65\).

\[
\boxed{65}
\]
